caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a brown and tan background, featuring symmetrical floral and leaf patterns in green, brown, and yellow shades. In the center of the plate is a circular geometric starburst design, made up of alternating green and brown leaf-like segments with inner lines and shading, surrounded by a ring of pointed triangles in green, brown, and yellow. Four large flowers, each with green petals and brown centers, are placed equidistant around the edge of the starburst circle, their stems extending outward and intertwining with flowing green leaves. Two tulip-like flowers with brown and yellow petals are positioned at the upper left and upper right sections of the plate, each attached to a curving green stem. Green splotches are scattered along the rim of the plate. Above the central motif is the year "1793" written in brown. In the lower right corner along the edge of the plate, the artist's signature "M. L. Antisurn" appears in reddish-brown ink. The background off the plate is plain and cream-colored.
title: Pa. German Pie Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
